description_en: Performs a paging query to retrieve the list of bookmarks under a specified cloud browser group or delivery group set
description_zh: 分页查询指定云浏览器组或交付组集合下的书签列表
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center list-browser-bookmarks --browser-instance-group-id 'big-0c7loey7fzjq****' --browser-instance-group-set-id set-3jm9d0abc00example --keyword example.com --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListBrowserBookmarks

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud browser group. You must specify either this parameter or BrowserInstanceGroupSetId, but not both
parameters.help_zh: 云浏览器组标识。与 `BrowserInstanceGroupSetId` 必须且只能指定一个
parameters.name: browser_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the browser delivery group set. You must specify either this parameter or BrowserInstanceGroupId, but not both
parameters.help_zh: 浏览器交付组集合 ID。BrowserInstanceGroupSetId 与 BrowserInstanceGroupId 必须且只能指定一个
parameters.name: browser_instance_group_set_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword used for partial matching of the bookmark name or URL. The matching is case-insensitive for English characters. The keyword can be up to 1,024 characters in length after leading and trailing spaces are removed. If this parameter is not specified or contains only spaces, no filtering is performed. Special characters are matched literally
parameters.help_zh: 书签名称或 URL 的包含匹配关键词。英文不区分大小写，去除首尾空白后最多 1024 字符；未传或纯空白表示不筛选，特殊字符按字面匹配
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 200
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的记录数。取值范围：1~200
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，从第 1 页开始
parameters.name: page_number

Data.description_en: The bookmarks on the current page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的标识，用于排查问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of bookmarks that meet the filtering conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的书签总数
